skill_gap.name: stage B contradicts board shape
skill_gap.why: stage B routes to P5 whenever the player does not move through a space, but Strategy's board-grid shape is defined as a board players act on rather than move through; read literally, every board game is P5 and the shape can never be reached, so the two rules disagree and only judgement resolves it
